source:
@@U01303@@
Yes! Well! But just think!
It killed him off!
Now, if I were in your shoes,
I'd spend the next year decently mourning,
and in the meantime shop around
for a replacement sweetheart.

@@U01305@@
God knows, I'll never find another like my first!
What a sweet little fool that rascal was.
He was just too fond of foreign ports,
of foreign wines, and foreign women,
and then those blasted dice.

@@U01307@@
Yes, well, how nice it might have been
if he'd overlooked as many peccadilloes
in you as you did in him.
With that as a condition, madam,
I wouldn't mind taking you on myself.

@@U01309@@
Oh, sir, how you do jest!

@@U01311@@
(Aside.)

@@U01312@@
I'd best get out of here before it’s too late!
She'd hold even the Devil to his word.

@@U01313@@
(To 格蕾琴.)

@@U01314@@
And how are things with your heart, dear?

@@U01316@@
What do you mean, sir?

@@U01318@@
(Aside.)

@@U01319@@
Sweet innocent child!
translation:
@@U01303@@
是的！出色地！但想想吧！
就这样害死了他！
现在，如果我处于你的立场，
我会在接下来的一年里体面地哀悼，
同时货比三家
作为替代甜心。

@@U01305@@
天知道，我再也找不到像我的第一个这样的人了！
那个流氓真是个可爱的小傻瓜。
他只是太喜欢外国港口了，
外国葡萄酒和外国女人，
然后是那些该死的骰子。

@@U01307@@
是的，好吧，那该多好啊
如果他忽略了同样多的过失
在你身上就像你在他身上一样。
以此为条件 女士
我不介意亲自带你去。

@@U01309@@
噢，先生，你真是开玩笑啊！

@@U01311@@
（旁边。）

@@U01312@@
我最好离开这里，以免为时已晚！
即使是魔鬼她也会信守诺言。

@@U01313@@
（对格蕾琴。）

@@U01314@@
亲爱的，你的心怎么样？

@@U01316@@
先生，您是什么意思？

@@U01318@@
（旁边。）

@@U01319@@
可爱无辜的孩子！
